text: In the Santa Clara at-large Mayor race, CAIR-SFBA's tracker records Kevin Park as supporting a ceasefire resolution and a "United Against Hate" resolution, while recording Karen Hardy and Kathy Watanabe each as having opposed the ceasefire resolution and supported the "United Against Hate" resolution. A Silicon Valley Voice opinion article credits Park with championing a Gaza ceasefire resolution, noting the effort to introduce it was blocked. CAIR Action lists Park as preferred for the general phase; BAMC Action lists him as supported, commenting that he "has been consistent in support of Muslims." Ro Khanna is listed as an endorser of Watanabe.
